title: World Entity and Structural Intelligence Operations: From Variable-Size Block Indexing to Open-Ended World Modeling, Metric Discovery, and Self-Referential Intelligence
description:
World Entity and Structural Intelligence Operations (WE-SIO), v0.1.0 is a hypothesis-driven research framework connecting World Entity representations, typed perspectives, WE-Hybrid Differential Trees (WE-HDT), Perspective-Adaptive Variable Blocks (PAVB), Adaptive Variable-Intelligence Blocks (AVIB), Metric Leaf Intelligence Units (MLIU), Two-Ways CCC, residual-first scientific discovery, candidate metric and perspective generation, Constrained Delta Evolution (CDE), self-modeling, and collective learning.

The release supplies conceptual papers, specifications, case studies, extensions, research-trace registries, counterexamples, testable hypotheses, and a validation roadmap. Proposed architectures and scientific-discovery mechanisms remain research hypotheses; no empirical validation or clinical effectiveness is claimed. The project prioritizes specifications and contracts before runtime, conformance before performance, evidence before promotion, and explicit preservation of unresolved research questions.
notes: Initial research-framework release (v0.1.0). DOI will be assigned by Zenodo upon publication. The listed AI collaborator is credited consistently with the repository CITATION.cff; confirm repository and Zenodo authorship policies before publication.
